liz-cs: Hey team — customer on our startup-pro plan reports rendered Markdown now has extra trailing tokens after today's rollout. It breaks codeblocks in their UI. They pasted a sample; need quick triage.

omar-eng: can you share request_id + model + params? any http error codes?

liz-cs: request_id: req_0a1b2c3d, model: rwd-llama-2.1-quant, variant: v2.1-prod-rollout-2026-03, params: {"stop":["\n\n"], "max_tokens":256, "temperature":0.2}

liz-cs: here's the response body the customer pasted (truncated):
````
Response (truncated):
```python
def add(a,b):
    return a + b
```
▁▁
````
(there's an extra "▁▁" sequence after the closing fence)

sophia-ml: :eyes: looks like trailing tokenization artifacts. do we have token-level output from the serving runtime? might be stop sequence not recognized, fallback behavior emitting tokenizer-specific bytes.

liz-cs: attached raw tokens the customer captured: ["def"," add","(","a",",","b",")",":","\n","    ","return"," a"," +"," b","\n","```","▁","▁"] — last tokens look unexpected.

omar-eng: that's useful. those two "▁" tokens map to whitespace subtokens introduced by the new tokenizer mapping deployed in v2.1. Canary started today at 14:03 UTC. @deploy-bot any rollout notes?

deploy-bot: Canary deployment "v2.1-prod-rollout" started at 2026-03-12T14:03:00Z in us-west-1 (20% traffic). No rollbacks recorded.

kai-ops: i'll try to repro locally with the exact model+params and same stop sequence. spinning a canary instance now.

sophia-ml: hypothesis: when stop=["\n\n"] the tokenizer sometimes emits newline as separate subtokens; our stop matching runs on token boundaries and misses the sequence, leaving trailing subtokens. Fix options: post-decode stop matching (safer for correctness) or adjust tokenizer mapping (more perf-sensitive).

omar-eng: quick mitigation — route affected customer to previous variant v2.0-stable until we patch. @kai-ops can you add routing rule for request_id + org id?

kai-ops: routing rule applied. req_0a1b2c3d and org org_77 now go to v2.0-stable. Canary traffic set back to 0% per SRE playbook.

liz-cs: customer confirmed UI is fixed after routing. they said codeblocks render normally now, thanks. :white_check_mark:

sophia-ml: i'll open an issue to patch tokenizer mapping and add a regression test that validates trailing fences and stop sequences across whitespace variants. plan to prioritize hotfix for tomorrow's release.

omar-eng: please file an incident and link the GH issue here so we can track. good catch, team.
